entries.text: 简化工作空间创建 DTO 的密码过滤逻辑
entries.textEn: Simplified password filtering in the workspace-creation DTO

entries.text: MySQL 连接启用 SSL/TLS，以支持 require_secure_transport=ON
entries.textEn: MySQL connections use SSL/TLS to support require_secure_transport=ON

entries.text: 统一工作空间创建逻辑，移除硬编码的数据库类型常量
entries.textEn: Unified workspace creation and removed hardcoded database-type constants

entries.text: 移除创建工作空间时 database 字段的非空校验
entries.textEn: Removed the non-null validation on the database field when creating a workspace

entries.text: DDL 迁移目录加序号前缀，shared 改为 01-common
entries.textEn: DDL migration directories gained sequence prefixes; shared became 01-common

entries.text: DDL 目录新增 03-wip，baseline 文件带上日期
entries.textEn: Added 03-wip for in-flight work; baseline files carry a date

entries.text: DDL 目录移到 docs/ 下，并新增开发者与 AI 指南
entries.textEn: Moved DDL under docs/ and added developer and AI guides

entries.text: DDL 移到 cloud/src/main/resources/ 下，移除旧脚本目录
entries.textEn: Moved DDL under cloud/src/main/resources/ and removed the old script directory

entries.text: 建立统一的数据库脚本管理：baseline + migrations + archive
entries.textEn: Established unified database script management: baseline + migrations + archive

entries.text: 新增环境变量模板文件并更新配置管理方式
entries.textEn: Added an environment-variable template and changed configuration management

entries.text: 达梦慢查询参数校验优化，部分参数获取失败时兜底
entries.textEn: Dameng slow-query parameter validation falls back when some parameters cannot be read

entries.text: 摘要与 SQL 详情接口返回规则预警级别信息
entries.textEn: Summary and SQL-detail endpoints return rule severity information

entries.text: 使用格式化后的 SQL 语句进行审核，获取正确的行号
entries.textEn: Review uses the formatted SQL statement to report correct line numbers

entries.text: 完善工单执行中跳过步骤的状态校验与结果处理
entries.textEn: Completed state validation and result handling for skipped ticket steps
